name: Kanie (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kanie town emblem in green: a disc crossed by three white horizontal bars.
history: Municipal flag of Kanie, a town in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in 1934.

features.role: Kanie town emblem — a disc crossed by three white horizontal bars
